title: Rebirth
next_chapter_hook: As the dimensional rift closed, Chen Ji sensed a gaze from the depths of fate—though the Heavenly Eye had departed, the final dark chess piece it had placed was quietly taking shape.

text.content: In the void, Chen Ji stood alone beyond the river of destiny. He lowered his gaze to his hands, which had once borne the weight of countless death prophecies. The death scene from Chapter 700 had now dissolved like morning mist, leaving only clarity behind. He remembered himself in that prophecy—collapsed in a pool of blood, the light in his eyes gradually fading. Now that ending had become nothingness, replaced by infinitely extending possibilities. A thousand years of scheming, endless calculations, countless sacrifices—all received their best reward at this moment.

dialogue.content: What are you standing there spacing out for?

text.content: The familiar voice came from behind. Chen Ji turned to see Su Qingyao stepping through the void, surrounded by a faint spiritual light. A thousand years had left barely a trace on her; only those eyes had become deeper, containing the wisdom of one who had seen through the world's affairs. She was the sole witness to his rise from waste to master of destiny, and also the confidante who had always stood by his side.

dialogue.content: I'm looking at an old friend.

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile containing a thousand years of vicissitudes and the tranquility of this moment. The death prophecy of Chapter 700 had once hung over his head like a sword, keeping him awake at night. Now that sword had vanished, replaced by infinite possibilities. He stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Su Qingyao, together gazing upon the reshaped three realms.

dialogue.content: The fourth possibility... we actually did it.

text.content: Su Qingyao turned to look at Chen Ji, tears glistening in her eyes. The three endings the Tianji Record had shown—becoming a puppet of the Heavenly Way, burning oneself out, or being devoured by destiny—had all been replaced by the fourth possibility. And the realization of this possibility relied on their mutual trust and perseverance.

dialogue.content: From waste to chess player, it took me a thousand years. But without you, I wouldn't even have had the qualification to join the game.

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's tears, how does Chen Ji choose to respond to this thousand-year bond of affection?

choices.description: Beyond destiny, Chen Ji chooses to review every moment of the journey with Su Qingyao, from the initial mutual probing to the final fighting side by side
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the Complete Effect of 'Shared Fate'
choices.risk_hint: Immersing in memories might miss the first opportunity of rebirth

text.content: Chen Ji gently grasped Su Qingyao's hand, the touch warm and real. He began to tell the story, starting from the scene of first meeting her in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters. Back then, she was the lofty Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, while he was the waste everyone could bully.

dialogue.content: The first time you investigated me, I knew you were the only person who could see through me. Unfortunately, you were wrong. I'm not a genius hiding my strength—I'm just a gambler unwilling to be manipulated by destiny.

choices.description: Chen Ji chooses to look ahead at plans for the three realms of the new age with Su Qingyao, how they will jointly guard this hard-won peace
choices.visible_cost: Give Up the Chance to Review the Past
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the New Era Opening Buff
choices.risk_hint: Failing to properly review may leave emotional regrets

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand to point at the reshaped three realms, where the rules were no longer controlled by the Heavenly Eye. He began to paint an entirely new blueprint: interconnection of the three realms, all things in their proper places, no more enslavement by destiny.

dialogue.content: This new world... have you figured out how to guard it?

choices.description: Chen Ji decides to stop dwelling on the past or future, wanting only to share this hard-won tranquility with Su Qingyao at this moment
choices.risk_hint: An unplotted new era may be full of uncertainties

text.content: Chen Ji didn't speak, only gently pulling Su Qingyao into his embrace. A thousand years of scheming and planning all dissolved into this simple hug. He felt her heartbeat—that was proof of being alive.

dialogue.content: The past is set, the future is unknown. Only this moment belongs truly to us.

text.content: Just at this warm moment, a familiar voice broke the serenity. "Brother—" Chen Nian's figure emerged from the void, surrounded by light similar to but gentler than the Heavenly Eye. She was no longer the little girl taken away by the Holy Sect, but a new existence who had inherited part of the Observer's authority.

dialogue.content: I saw the entire web of destiny, and I saw everything you did for me. All these years, you were always looking for me.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes slightly reddened. Finding Chen Nian was one of the most important threads in his thousand-year scheme, and also his greatest weakness. Now his sister stood before him, becoming his left and right arm in a completely new form. The power of the Heavenly Fate Key was no longer a shackle, but protection.

dialogue.content: I promised you that I would make destiny bow to you. From now on, you are free.
Brother, I don't want freedom. I want to be with you, guarding this new world.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian requests to join the ranks guarding the new world—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Accept Chen Nian's request, letting her formally become one of the guardians of the new world
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian obtains the title 'Heavenly Fate Guardian'

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, reaching out to gently pat Chen Nian's head, just like when she was young. At this moment, a thousand years seemed to have never existed.

dialogue.content: From now on, brother and sister stand side by side. If destiny dares to offend again, let it see the spirit of the Chen family.

choices.description: Worried about the dangers of the new world, only let Chen Nian provide support from behind the scenes
choices.visible_cost: May make Chen Nian feel distrusted

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, his gaze containing both worry and determination. He didn't want his sister to fall into danger again, even though her power was now enough to protect herself.

dialogue.content: I know brother is worried about me. But I'm no longer the little girl who needed to be protected back then.

text.content: Ripples appeared again in the void, and a familiar figure slowly manifested. Mo Xiansheng—the mentor who had once guarded the Tianji Record as a fragmented soul—now appeared before everyone in mortal form. His body was no longer translucent but solid flesh, and though the ancient wisdom in his eyes remained, it now carried the warmth of worldly fires.

dialogue.content: The chess game has ended, and the guardian's mission should conclude too. From now on, I'm just an ordinary person witnessing the legacy.

text.content: Chen Ji bowed deeply to Mo Xiansheng. Throughout this thousand years, Mo Xiansheng had guarded the Tianji Record as a fragmented soul, each volume unlocking part of the truth while always presenting itself as a riddle. Now he could finally lay down his burden and spend his remaining years as a mortal.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record has been completely unsealed, and all the truths are within your heart. The road ahead, you must walk yourself.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure gradually became blurry—he was reshaping his rebirth as a mortal, destined to walk through worldly fires for his remaining years. Chen Ji watched him depart, heart filled with both reluctance and blessings. The guardian's mission was complete, and the new era would be written by them themselves.

dialogue.content: Seems I've arrived at just the right time.

text.content: A black figure walked out from the dimensional rift—it was Ye Qing, the former Demon Path Saintess, now an independent entity serving as a bridge between the three realms and the dimensions. Her Demon Path Mists skill had not only concealed the aura of the Tianji Record but also turned the tide of battle at the crucial moment. Now she stood at the entrance to the reborn three realms, the gloom of former days gone from her eyes, replaced only by transcendence and composure.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye has departed, but I can sense its gaze from beyond the dimensions. The challenges of the new world are only just beginning.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, meeting Ye Qing's gaze. Once she was the Demon Path Saintess, and he was the waste disciple of Tianqing Sect; now they stood shoulder to shoulder, jointly guarding this reborn land. The prophecy in the Tianji Record that only she could understand had transformed from shackles of destiny into testament to friendship.

dialogue.content: With you guarding beyond the dimensions, I'm at ease. Whatever dark chess pieces the Heavenly Eye left behind, we can handle.

text.content: Ye Qing smiled faintly, that smile containing a thousand years of tacit understanding and hope for the future. She turned toward the dimensional rift, Demon Path Mists forming a barrier behind her, separating the reborn three realms from unknown dangers.

choice.prompt: Facing the approaching separation, what does Chen Ji want to say to everyone?

choices.description: Proclaim the arrival of the Chen family's new era to everyone, displaying the bearing of a destiny master
choices.visible_reward: All allies obtain the 'Rebirth Shelter' buff
choices.risk_hint: May attract the attention of hidden forces

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed everyone, his eyes blazing with regal light. He said: "A thousand years of scheming, concluded today. From now on, destiny is dictated by me, not heaven!"
As his words fell, the three realms trembled. Su Qingyao, Chen Nian, Ye Qing—every person's eyes burned with the same flame. They were no longer chess pieces of destiny, but pioneers of a new world.

choices.description: Thank every companion who fought side by side, cherish this hard-won friendship
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the hidden achievement 'Aspects of All Beings'

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, bowing deeply to each person. Throughout this thousand years, too many had paid the price for his chess game; now was the time to express the most sincere gratitude.

dialogue.content: Thank you all—if not for you, there would be no me today.

choices.description: Use his usual sharp-tongued style to tease everyone, easing the atmosphere of parting
choices.visible_cost: May make the atmosphere overly light
choices.visible_reward: Everyone obtains the special status 'Chen Family Humor'
choices.risk_hint: May destroy the solemnity of parting

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laugh carrying his usual mischievousness: "Everyone, the thousand-year chess game is over—no one is ever getting me to scheme again. Too exhausting."

dialogue.content: Save it, I'm still waiting to see you continue calculating in the new world.

text.content: Everyone dispersed, each embarking on a new journey. Ye Qing returned beyond the dimensional rift, Su Qingyao went back to Tianqing Sect to oversee大局, and Chen Nian began traveling throughout the three realms, guarding every corner with her Observer's Eye. Mo Xiansheng's figure had long vanished into the fires of the mortal world.

Chen Ji stood alone at the center of the reborn three realms, feeling the pulse of this land beneath his feet. Once he was the waste everyone spat upon; now he was the one who rewrote destiny. A thousand years of scheming, countless choices,无数次生死边缘的游走—everything was worth it.

The dimensional rift slowly closed overhead, the light gradually dimming. Just as it was about to disappear completely, Chen Ji sensed a profound gaze piercing through from beyond the rift—the Heavenly Eye. Though it had departed, it had not been utterly destroyed.

Chen Ji raised his head, staring at the rift slowly closing. His eyes held no fear, only unwavering light. The Heavenly Eye had once been his nightmare; now it was merely the final stepping stone on his path to the top.

dialogue.content: My destiny is written by me—but so is yours.

text.content: The dimensional rift closed completely, the reborn three realms bathed in gentle light. Chen Ji turned and stepped onto the road home. Ahead lay Su Qingyao's waiting, Chen Nian's laughter, the endless possibilities of the new world. He was no longer a chess piece, but the chess player; no longer waste, but master of destiny. The Tianji Record's mission was complete, but his story had only just begun.
